title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Connection Reuse and Resumption Tickets Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests for idle-timeout reuse gating, ticket tracking, connectivity-change detection, address validation policy, and server option defaults.
scope: This verification covers client-side idle-timeout reuse gating, ticket single-use, connectivity-change detection, address validation token policy, and server-side resumption ticket lifetime and anti-replay options. REQ-0103 (edns-tcp-keepalive) is verified by slice 0008.
expected_result: All DoQ tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9250 artifacts including slice 0014, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: All 8 REQs are now traced and verified. Policy-layer idle-timeout reuse gating, ticket single-use, connectivity-change detection, address validation gating, ticket lifetime, and anti-replay are implemented.
